flowRoot.flowPara: TIP: The first skill you play in a turn generates 1 Heat. The second generates 2 and every subsequent skill played that turn generates 3. Heat can be used to Ignite skills (play them for free) or saved to gain Health via Dissipation. When you Ignite a skill, it doesn't generate Heat itself but it still counts as a skill played, increasing Heat generation for subsequent skills tha turn.
TIP: Leave the booklet open to this page as you will use these skills frequently!
TIP: This is your Innate skill. That means its always active. In tandem with the Ignite keyword detailed below, it's a vital part of the Kindleborne's skill-set.
TIP: This is your Basic skill. It's a lot weaker than most of your other skills, but it never needs to recharge.
You may consume Heat equal to a skill's Ignite cost to play that skill without spending an action. Skills played this way do not generate Heat.
Whenever you use a skill, you gain 1 Heat for each skill you’ve used this turn (max gain: 3).
At end of turn, if you have more than 5 heat, consume half of your heat and gain that much health.
Ignite 5 (Consume 5 Heat to play this skill for free).
Strike target foe for 4 damage plus 1 bonus damage for each attack skill you’ve used this turn.
